These supplementary materials provide evidence and methodological details supporting the main article.

*Authors: Alexander Holland, Stanislav Roudavski, Jason Thompson and Philip Gibbons*

[click here for a live version of the simulation](https://arboreal-futures-live.gigglycarp1.chatgpt.site/)

## Appendices

| Appendix | Contents |
|---|---|
| [Appendix A: Glossary](appendices/appendix_A_glossary.qmd) | Defines the shared conceptual vocabulary. |
| [Appendix B: Supporting evidence for the vignettes](appendices/appendix_B_vignette_evidence.qmd) | Provides background evidence for the vignettes. |
| [Appendix C: Places](appendices/appendix_C_places.qmd) | Describes the places, locations and model boundaries. |
| [Appendix D: Personas and capabilities](appendices/appendix_D_personas_and_capabilities.qmd) | Documents personas, species and sampled capabilities. |
| [Appendix E: Capability groups and indicators](appendices/appendix_E_capability_groups_and_indicators.qmd) | Explains the capability groups related to the personas and how we define the indicators the model uses to measure them. |
| [Appendix F: Habitat features](appendices/appendix_F_habitat_features.qmd) | Documents the workflow for deriving habitat features from laser scans, including their calibration and variants. |
| [Appendix G: Habitat volumes](appendices/appendix_G_habitat_volumes.qmd) | Documents the data inputs and construction of the voxel grid. |
| [Appendix H: Resistance](appendices/appendix_H_resistance.qmd) | Describes the resistance parameters and the cellular automata calculation for connectivity. |
| [Appendix I: Proposals and interventions](appendices/appendix_I_proposals_and_interventions.qmd) | Describes proposal families and community responses. |
| [Appendix J: Pathway simulation](appendices/appendix_J_pathway_simulation.qmd) | Documents the pathway simulation and its implementation. |
| [Appendix K: Baseline woodlands](appendices/appendix_K_baseline_woodlands.qmd) | Documents the evidence and calculations for the woodland reference state. |
| [Appendix L: Extended results](appendices/appendix_L_extended_results.qmd) | Provides year-180 indicator quantities, all-years comparisons and tree population quantities. |

### Pathway simulation submodules

- [Appendix J.1: Tree growth submodule](appendices/appendix_J1_tree_growth.qmd)
- [Appendix J.2: Tree lifecycle submodule](appendices/appendix_J2_tree_lifecycle.qmd)
- [Appendix J.3: Recruitment and mortality submodule](appendices/appendix_J3_recruitment_and_mortality.qmd)
